hero.title: SAT / ACT
hero.lead: Private, personalized preparation for the SAT, SAT II subject tests and the ACT.

intro.lead: Private and personalized one-on-one tutoring for SAT English and Math, SAT II subject tests, and ACT exam preparation.
intro.body: Online sessions are prioritized so students can work from home on a schedule that fits around school; small group options are available for students who prefer to prepare alongside classmates.

weekend.title: Weekend SAT prep

cards.title: 4.5-hour Saturday sessions
cards.text: Three 90-minute instructional blocks covering Critical Reading, Writing and Math — the full test in one sitting each week.

cards.title: Weekly practice exams
cards.text: Full-length practice exams on Tuesdays or Fridays, 4:00–7:30 PM, with graded assessments so progress is measured, not guessed at.

ticks: Critical Reading, Writing and Math in every session
Graded assessments for week-over-week progress tracking

summer.title: Summer intensive SAT/ACT online bootcamp
summer.lead: A concentrated summer program for students testing in the fall — the full curriculum, compressed and taught online.

registration.title: Official test dates
registration.lead: Register directly with the testing organizations — we will help you choose which date to sit for.
